item.title: Q3FY26: IEX Profit Up 11% YoY to Rs 119.1 Cr; 9M Profit Rises to Rs 363.1 Cr
item.description: Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) recorded a surge in electricity volumes in Q3FY’26, with volumes reaching 34.1 BUs, an increase of 11.9% year-on-year (YoY). In a press release, IEX said its consolidated revenue for the quarter rose to Rs 183.1 crore, marking a 14% increase from Rs 160.5 crore in Q3FY’25. item.title: North Seas Countries Sign Offshore Wind Investment Pact, Target 15 GW Annual Buildout from 2031
item.description: Seven Heads of State and Government and Energy Ministers from nine North Seas countries met in Hamburg on Tuesday to accelerate the expansion of offshore wind capacity across Europe. Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, Ireland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway and the United Kingdom reaffirmed their ambition to collectively deploy 300 GW of offshore wind capacity in the North Seas by 2050. item.title: Acme Solar Q3 FY 26 Results On Track With 54% Growth, Margins Under Pressure
item.description: ACME Solar Holdinmgs Limited (Acme Solar), bucked the trend for developers in Q3 with a strong show. The firm reported revenue of INR 617 Cr in Q3, a 54% year-over-year increase, and EBITDA of INR 564 Cr, up 57% year-over-year. Key highlights include the partial commissioning of a 72 MW wind project, bringing the YTD commissioned capacity to 422 MW, and PPAs signed for 450 MW projects, increasing the cumulative YTD PPA signed capacity to 1,050 MW. item.title: KPI Green Energy Lines up Sundrop Energia IPO, Sharpens Focus on Storage and EPC Pipeline
item.description: KPI Green Energy delivered its ‘seventh consecutive quarter of highest ever revenue’ in Q3 FY26, led by execution across its solar and hybrid portfolio. item.title: Websol Energy Q3 Profit Climbs To ₹65 Crore On Strong Cell Line Ramp-Up
item.description: Kolkata-based Websol Energy System Limited (Websol), a leading manufacturer of high-efficiency solar cells and modules in India, reported a 77.2% year-on-year rise in revenue from operations to ₹261 crore in the December quarter, compared with ₹147 crore in Q3 FY25. Websol Energy said its EBITDA rose to ₹106 crore, with a margin of 40.8%, from ₹68 crore a year earlier. item.title: BPCL Inaugurates 71 MWp Solar Power Plant in Prayagraj at IEW
item.description: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) has inaugurated a 71 MWp DC / 52 MW AC solar power plant in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The project was inaugurated by Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas Hardeep Singh Puri during India Energy Week (IEW).
